sample_mapping_evidence: Primary paper establishes eight distinct participants, four per group, in the whole-transcriptome PBMC cohort. Eight original GSM/library labels are specimen and study-scoped recipient proxies. Replicate ordinals are not interpreted as repeated draws or inferred clinical patient IDs.
physical_sample_mapping_evidence: Eight original whole-PBMC RNA libraries, four per treatment group. Primary publication explicitly describes a separate cohort of eight distinct participants for whole-transcriptome PBMC analysis. GEO library titles are study-scoped participant proxies; clinical participant identifiers and individual days are unassigned. Each library is one specimen; no identity inferred from barcode or replicate numbering.

source_metadata.clinical_policy: Post-allogeneic transplantation for hematologic malignancy; source collection interval16-21days is not an exact per-person day. Preserve original OrcaT/PBSC labels. Individual age, sex, underlying malignancy subtype and clinical participant aliases remain unassigned. A transplant specimen may contain donor-derived and recipient-derived cells; do not interpret recipient proxy as the genetic origin of every cell.
source_metadata.reuse_policy: Only GSE290836 whole-PBMC whole-transcriptome libraries acquired. The separate GSE290864 targeted399gene sorted-cell cohort and GSE312099 chromatin assay are not added. Primary study total51participants is not a count of scRNA specimens. Global cross-study recipient/graft-donor aliases unresolved.
source_metadata.gene_policy: All37468original RNA feature IDs and symbols retained in exact supplied order. No highly variable gene selection, symbol modernization, intersection or zero filling.
source_metadata.count_semantics: Provided original Fluent PIPseq whole-PBMC gene counts, STAR-aligned as reported in GEO and the primary publication; all stored values verified finite nonnegative integers. No inverse normalization or rounding.
source_metadata.source_limitations: Study-scoped recipient proxies only. No genetic-origin assignment, cross-study unique-person proof, biological annotation validation or constellation validation.
